title: A Novel Compound Enniatin G from the Mangrove Fungus Halosarpheia sp. (strain #732) from the South China Sea
abstract: A novel cyclic depsipeptide, enniatin G, together with enniatins B and B4 were isolated from the mangrove fungus Halosarpheia sp. (strain 732) from the South China Sea. Their structures were determined by analysis of spectroscopic data, mainly two-dimensional nuclear magnetic resonance experiments. Enniatin G exhibited activity against Heps 7402, ED 50 12mg/mL.
